name: mercy
description: Workflow intelligence for agentic-mercy-10x: session ledger, Python hook bridge (advisories off the critical path), guards, verification gate, repo brain, router governor, skill-listing focus, auto-resume after usage limits, and the UI deck (pane, action band, toasts, sounds, desktop notifications, git/CI/usage views, slash command cards)

bridge.title: Python hook bridge
bridge.description: on: the mod decides when owned dispatch.py links run (advisories in the background, rare links only when they can fire). off: dispatch.py runs every link synchronously as before.

tddGuard.title: tdd-guard timing
tddGuard.description: async: validate after the write and deliver the advisory on the next step (no blocking). sync: the old blocking PreToolUse behaviour. off: skip tdd-guard.

guard.title: Guard
guard.description: Deny dev servers and watchers, subagent commits and pushes, and live-looking secrets in writes.

verifyGate.title: Verification gate
verifyGate.description: block: once per turn, stop the model from finishing when code changed after the last passing test/typecheck/build and a verify command is known. advise: toast only.

dedupeWindow.title: Router dedupe window (turns)
dedupeWindow.description: Drop prompt-router blocks and skill pushes repeated within this many turns (0 = governor off).

brain.title: Repo brain
brain.description: Learn verified commands, fixes and notes per repo across sessions; show them as one stable system prompt section.

focus.title: Skill listing focus
focus.description: Inside a git repo, leave the business-plugin skill families listed in focusHide out of the model's skill listing (they still run by name).

focusHide.title: Hidden skill families
focusHide.description: Comma-separated plugin prefixes left out of the skill listing in code repos.

autoResume.title: Auto-resume after usage limits
autoResume.description: When a turn dies on a usage limit or overload, resume the task automatically when the limit resets.

pulse.title: UI mode
pulse.description: full: status, action band, pane on wide terminals, toasts, sound, desktop notifications, compact rows. focus: no auto pane, toasts for failures only, no restyled rows. quiet: status line only. off: nothing visible. /ui overrides it across sessions.

sound.title: Sounds
sound.description: Play the desktop sound theme when a long turn ends, a turn fails, or Claude waits for you (Linux: canberra-gtk-play, then pw-play, paplay; macOS: afplay; Windows: the Windows Media wav through powershell.exe, then SystemSounds).

soundAfter.title: Sound after (seconds)
soundAfter.description: A finished turn plays the done sound and toasts only when it ran at least this long.

notify.title: Desktop notifications
notify.description: A desktop notification when a long turn ends or Claude waits for a permission answer (Linux: notify-send; Windows: a toast through powershell.exe).

notifyAfter.title: Notify after (seconds)
notifyAfter.description: A finished turn sends a desktop notification only when it ran at least this long.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: No sound or desktop notification in this local time window, e.g. 22-07 or 22:30-07:00. Empty: never quiet.

paneAuto.title: Open the pane by itself
paneAuto.description: In full mode, open the /pulse pane at session start; the engine seats an unasked pane only on terminals 144+ columns wide.

ci.title: GitHub CI watch
ci.description: Poll the current branch's PR checks (or workflow runs) with gh every 3 minutes and after a push; toast and band on a change.

autoCompact.title: Compact between turns at (context %)
autoCompact.description: After a turn ends with context at or above this, mercy compacts the conversation before your next prompt, keeping the plan, open tasks and unverified files, instead of the engine compacting mid-task. At most every 10 minutes. 0 turns it off.
